## Summary
A clear and concise description of the requested feature.

## User story
As a <type of user>, I want <some goal> so that <some reason>.

## Proposed solution
Describe the proposed change or approach. Include UI mockups or examples if applicable.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Criteria 1 (what must be true for this feature to be considered done)
- [ ] Criteria 2

## Alternatives considered
If there are alternative approaches, list them and why they were rejected.

## Risks / Dependencies
Any known risks, dependencies, or migration steps.

## Implementation notes (optional)
Technical notes, API changes, DB migrations, etc.

## Priority
- Low / Medium / High
